general.title: MOSuite-clean
general.instructions: clean raw counts in a multiOmicsDataSet

parameters.name: Clean up column names
parameters.description: Automatically alter invalid column names by adding X prefix to names starting with numerals and replacing special characters (-,:. ) with underscores

parameters.name: Split gene names
parameters.description: Split the gene name column by special characters: ,|_-:

parameters.name: Aggregate duplicate gene names
parameters.description: Sum counts across duplicate Feature ID rows into a single row within each sample
parameters.help_text: When TRUE, additional identifier columns (e.g. Ensembl IDs) are preserved and multiple matching identifiers appear as comma-separated values.

parameters.name: Column for collapsing duplicates
parameters.description: Column with Feature IDs to use as grouping elements to collapse the counts matrix
parameters.help_text: Leave blank to use the Feature ID column by default. If the Feature ID column can be split, the non-Ensembl ID name will be used. If no Ensembl IDs are detected, split IDs will be named Feature_id_1 and Feature_id_2.

parameters.name: count type
parameters.description: which counts to clean. Must be a count type in names(moo@counts)

parameters.name: Sample ID Column Name
parameters.description: Column name in the sample metadata containing sample IDs
parameters.help_text: Leave blank to use the first column in the sample metadata by default

parameters.name: Feature ID column name
parameters.description: Column name in the counts matrix containing feature IDs
parameters.help_text: Leave blank to use the first column by default
